<?php
$cnx = mysqli_connect("127.0.0.1", "root", "", "bd_2025_2026");

$login      = $_POST["login"];
$password   = $_POST["password"];
$nom        = $_POST["nom"];
$prenom     = $_POST["prenom"];
$date_naiss = $_POST["date_naiss"];
$heure      = $_POST["heure_naiss"];
$mail       = $_POST["mail"];
$sexe       = $_POST["sexe"];
$foot       = $_POST["foot"];
$hand       = $_POST["hand"];
$tennis     = $_POST["tennis"];
$pays       = $_POST["pays"];
$ville      = $_POST["ville"];
$remarques  = $_POST["remarques"];

$sql = "INSERT INTO aparticipant 
(login, password, nom, prenom, date_naiss, heure_naiss, mail, sexe, foot, hand, tennis, pays, ville, remarques) 
VALUES 
('$login', '$password', '$nom', '$prenom', '$date_naiss', '$heure', '$mail', '$sexe', '$foot', '$hand', '$tennis', '$pays', '$ville', '$remarques')";

if (mysqli_query($cnx, $sql)) {
    echo " Données insérées avec succès !";
} else {
    echo " Erreur : " ;
}

mysqli_close($cnx);
?>
